message.content:
<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
I've sent the email. Now I need to inform Alison that the email has been sent and that we need to wait for a response from the partners. I'll also note that I don't have a way to *receive* emails, so we'll need to figure out how we'll know if Elena can make it.

This is a key point. My `send_confirmation_email` function is a one-way street. I can't see replies. Alison will probably have to check for a new calendar entry or some other signal. I should mention this to her so we can plan for it.

However, I don't have a way to check for replies. I will have to assume that one of the partners will update their calendar, or that Alison has a way of seeing the reply. The most direct thing I can do is tell Alison I've sent the email and that we need to wait for the outcome.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>

function.arguments: {"text":"Hi Alison. I've sent the email proposing the Thursday 10:00 AM slot. We'll now need to wait for a response from the partners. I don't have a way to see any replies to the email, so we will need to monitor their calendars or have some other way of knowing if Elena is able to reschedule.\n\nI'll be on standby. Let me know if you see any updates."}
